title: Settlement Basis: Value Released from a Travel Credit Pool on Air Ticket Fare Brands
content:
# Air Ticket Fare Brands: Basis of the Value Released from a Travel Credit Pool

Where a traveller holds travel credit vouchers issued against a cancelled booking under Air Ticket Fare Brands, the value released is raised against the itinerary as credit toward its price. The value released from the traveller's pooled travel credit onto an unticketed itinerary they are holding is the value standing on the vouchers issued against the cancelled booking, less the redemptions already taken against them, and is never below zero.

## The quantities that enter the determination

| Quantity | How it is determined |
| --- | --- |
| The value standing issued | The total of every travel credit issue line standing against the cancelled booking, counted whatever term the voucher it raised runs for. |
| The redemptions already taken | The total of the redemption lines already taken against those vouchers, counted as a positive amount. |
| The open pool | The value standing issued, less the redemptions already taken; where that difference would fall below zero, the open pool is zero. |
| The pool available to the traveller | The whole of the open pool. |

## How the determination is assembled

The pool available to the traveller is settled first, and the value released is that pool once every share and every uplift that bears on it has been taken, each share and each uplift acting in turn on the figure the one before it gives, so that the figure runs on from one step to the next and is never reached by measuring them separately against the settled pool and netting the results together, with anything added in dollars added last of all. Where more than one share is taken on the same figure, the shares act one after another, each on the figure the one before it gives, and are never combined into a single rate; where more than one uplift is added to the same figure, the uplifts are combined into a single uplift and the figure is increased once by that total. The value released is rounded to two decimal places at the end and never at any intermediate step.

The whole of the open pool is released. Whatever is not released stays on the voucher it came off and keeps that voucher's own expiry, which runs for the credit validity term of the fare brand held. The redemption line is filed against the issue line that created the voucher and carries the traveller position of that line. The traveller releases the value themselves, because the vouchers stand in their own name.

## Worked determination on hypothetical figures

Every figure and every rate in what follows is hypothetical, chosen only to show the whole chain being carried, and no rate below is a published one. Take a cancelled booking against which travel credit issue lines of 900.00 and 300.00 stand: the value standing issued is 1,200.00. Redemption lines of 250.00 and 75.50 have already been taken, so the redemptions already taken are 325.50. The open pool is therefore 874.50, and the pool available to the traveller settles at that same figure. That settled pool is the stage the determination starts from, and the value released follows from it, step by step. Suppose a share of 0.72 bears on it: 874.50 taken at 0.72 gives 629.64. Suppose an uplift of 0.45 then bears on the figure that share gave: 629.64 increased by 0.45 gives 912.978. Each step is worked on the figure the step before it gave, and no step is worked on the 874.50 the pool settled at. Suppose 20.00 US dollars then falls to be added in dollars, which comes last of all, after every share and every uplift: 912.978 with 20.00 added gives 932.978. The figure is above zero, so the rule that it is never below zero leaves it as it stands, and rounding at the end leaves a value released of 932.98.

Take instead a booking whose issue lines total 400.00 and against which redemptions of 460.00 stand. The difference would fall below zero, so the open pool is zero, the pool available to the traveller settles at zero, and there is no value to release.
